images.title: Start after the word from
images.purpose: Show how to read subtract this from that: the number after from comes first, so subtract 13/4 from 10/3 becomes 10/3 − 13/4.
images.composition: A column of three question cards on the left with wide spacing, one curved arrow from the top card to a rewritten line on the right, and one rule line centred at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Left: 3 plain rounded cards stacked with equal spacing, each holding one question line in dark text. On the top card, the words from 10/3 are underlined in reddish purple #CC79A7. One curved reddish purple arrow runs from that underline to the right, ending at one rewritten line in which 10/3 is teal #0072B2 and 13/4 is amber #E69F00. Bottom, centred: one rule line. No laddoos, no people. Exactly 3 cards, 1 arrow, 1 rewritten line, 1 rule line.
labels: start with the number after from
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any result of any of the three subtractions shown, or 13/4 written first in the rewritten line
images.takeaway: The number after from is where you start.
images.description: Three questions of the form subtract this from that; an arrow from the words from 10/3 leads to the rewritten line 10/3 − 13/4 = ?, under the rule to start with the number after from. No answers are shown.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to read each card aloud and say which number comes first when it is written with a minus sign.

image_decisions.why: An arrow from the word from to the rewritten line makes the order of a take away visible, without giving any answer.
